$description: Phase 2 P2.1 — the motion dictionary (spec §3 Pillar E). 20 starter interaction patterns the design AI loads on activation. Each is tagged role=productive|expressive, carries SEMANTIC motion tokens (never raw ms/easing — the theme owns those), lists good-with/avoid, and a reduced-motion swap (rich by default, gracefully reduced — the owner's non-negotiable). role=expressive is the owner's default appetite (taste-profile.md).

roles.productive: efficient, informational — moves you through a task. Safe everywhere, incl. dense/data UI.
roles.expressive: characterful, celebratory, immersive — adds delight. The owner's default; reach for these on hero/CTA/marketing and key moments.

patterns.name: Button press
patterns.effect: scale 0.97 + slight shadow drop on :active
patterns.reducedMotion: keep the colour/tone change, drop the scale
patterns.description: Tactile confirmation a control received the press.

patterns.name: Hover elevate
patterns.effect: translateY(-2px) + shadow-card → shadow-card-hover
patterns.reducedMotion: swap the shadow only, no translate
patterns.description: A card/tile lifts toward the cursor to read as interactive.

patterns.name: Focus ring
patterns.effect: 2px action-coloured ring fades/scales in on :focus-visible
patterns.description: Keyboard focus is always visible; ≥3:1 contrast (floor, never flipped).

patterns.name: Menu open
patterns.effect: opacity 0→1 + translateY(-4px)→0, transform-origin top
patterns.description: Dropdown/popover enters from its trigger edge.

patterns.name: Modal enter
patterns.effect: backdrop fade + panel scale 0.96→1 + fade
patterns.description: A focused overlay grows in; backdrop dims the page.

patterns.name: Toast
patterns.effect: slide-in from edge + fade, auto-dismiss with a fade-out
patterns.description: Transient feedback that does not block; never the only cue for an error.

patterns.name: Skeleton → content
patterns.effect: shimmering skeleton cross-fades to real content
patterns.description: Perceived-performance placeholder matching the real layout.

patterns.name: Streamed load
patterns.effect: rows/tokens fade in as they arrive
patterns.description: Progressive reveal for streamed/AI content — feels alive as it fills.

patterns.name: Number count-up
patterns.effect: a KPI animates from 0 to its value (ease-out cubic)
patterns.description: Data feels alive on mount (taste: AnimatedNumber/NumberTicker).

patterns.name: List stagger
patterns.effect: children fade/slide-up in sequence (~40ms apart)
patterns.description: A list assembles with rhythm instead of popping in.

patterns.name: Tab slide
patterns.effect: an underline/pill slides to the active tab; panels cross-fade
patterns.reducedMotion: move the indicator instantly, no panel fade
patterns.description: Spatial continuity between tab states.

patterns.name: Accordion
patterns.effect: height auto expand/collapse + chevron rotate
patterns.reducedMotion: toggle open/closed with no height animation
patterns.description: Progressive disclosure with a measured expand.

patterns.name: Scroll reveal
patterns.effect: sections fade/slide-up as they enter the viewport (IntersectionObserver)
patterns.description: Marketing/hero storytelling (taste: Hyper Scroll).

patterns.name: 3D tilt
patterns.effect: perspective rotateX/Y toward the cursor + glare
patterns.reducedMotion: flat card, keep the shadow lift
patterns.description: Depth-on-hover; a signature for the owner (8/31 A-cards are 3D).

patterns.name: Drag reorder
patterns.effect: lifted item follows pointer; neighbours slide to make room
patterns.reducedMotion: instant reorder on drop, no slide
patterns.description: Direct manipulation for lists/boards.

patterns.name: Optimistic + undo
patterns.effect: apply the change immediately + a toast with UNDO
patterns.description: Responsiveness without waiting on the server; reversible.

patterns.name: Success check
patterns.effect: a checkmark draws in (stroke-dashoffset) + subtle scale
patterns.description: A satisfying completion moment (taste: one delight per surface).

patterns.name: Error shake
patterns.effect: a short horizontal shake + colour/icon change
patterns.reducedMotion: colour + icon + text change only, no shake
patterns.description: Draws the eye to an invalid field; NEVER colour-alone.

patterns.name: Chart tooltip
patterns.effect: a value tooltip fades/tracks to the hovered mark; crosshair follows
patterns.description: On-demand precise values without cluttering the chart.

patterns.name: Chart brush
patterns.effect: drag-select a range; the chart eases to the zoomed domain
patterns.description: Explore a time/quantity range interactively.
